brief:
More than 66 percent of ballots had been counted as of 9:20 a.m. local time, with partial results from the Central Elections Committee showing Benjamin Netanyahu's political bloc at 56 seats, according to Middle East Eye. The count was ongoing at the time of reporting.

The partial tally offered early indicators of the election's direction, though final results remained pending as vote-counting continued across Israel's electoral districts.
